title: pyrostegia venusta var. villosa
intro: Pyrostegia venusta var. villosa, commonly known as the orange trumpet vine, is a flowering plant in the bignonaceae family, known for its bright orange, trumpet-shaped flowers. The health benefits of the orange trumpet vine include its potential in reducing inflammation and anxiety, as well as its antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its sedative and antispasmodic effects, which can aid in reducing muscle cramps and promoting relaxation. The bioactive constituents of the orange trumpet vine include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
